## Security-sensitive changes

- [ ] Does not touch auth, secrets, policy, approvals, SSH host keys or command execution
- [ ] If it does: threat considered, negative tests added, no secret reaches logs, events or errors
- [ ] No new dependency, or its license and maintenance were reviewed
